task_analysis.description: The task involves reducing CPU-GPU synchronization overhead in a speculative decoding pipeline (EAGLE). Specifically, it requires replacing synchronous tensor operations and host-to-device transfers with asynchronous versions and pre-calculating values on the CPU to avoid blocking the GPU stream.

library_failure.failure_reason: The agent failed to identify that standard PyTorch operations like .item() and torch.tensor(device='cuda') cause implicit synchronizations that bottleneck high-performance inference engines.
